_doc: The three Poké Balls of Emerald's Johto starters on Prof. Birch's Lab table (emerald_ch11_gameclear, 2026-10-12). Switched on by emerald_rooms (2026-10-12): the Emerald Lab's table layout exists (LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Emerald_Table, an alt room of zone 396 whose three table tiles (8..10, 4) are solid with their collision height at the table top, solid_y 11, so the balls stand on it), EMJ_JOHTO_ON is 1 and this file was renamed from e_ch11_johto.json.off. The scene: scenes/emerald/BirchLab_JohtoStarters.inc. Test builds: HOENN_TEST_CHJOHTO=1 (state 4 forced).

objects.what: Poké Ball with Cyndaquil on Emerald's table (pokeemerald object CYNDAQUIL_BALL at (8,4); shown by EM_LabJohtoInit in states 4 and 5; scenes/emerald/BirchLab_JohtoStarters.inc)
Poké Ball with Totodile on Emerald's table (pokeemerald object TOTODILE_BALL at (9,4); shown by EM_LabJohtoInit in states 4 and 5; scenes/emerald/BirchLab_JohtoStarters.inc)
Poké Ball with Chikorita on Emerald's table (pokeemerald object CHIKORITA_BALL at (10,4); shown by EM_LabJohtoInit in states 4 and 5; scenes/emerald/BirchLab_JohtoStarters.inc)
